summary: Design traceable pharmaceutical and vaccine distribution controls, from qualification to last-mile delivery. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Pharmaceutical and vaccine distribution quality management helps health-programme supply-chain managers, pharmacists and logisticians control product conditions from receipt to delivery. Participants practise temperature mapping, equipment and route qualification, excursion assessment, and batch traceability using risk-based controls and quality records. They also review inventory risks and last-mile handovers so distribution decisions can be documented and explained.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, control, assess or document pharmaceutical and vaccine flows across health programmes, warehouses and humanitarian delivery networks.
prerequisites: Prior work in pharmaceutical, vaccine, medical or humanitarian supply-chain operations is expected. Familiarity with warehouse or distribution records is useful. No coding or programming is required; basic spreadsheet use is sufficient for the Excel-based review exercises.
